en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a calm canal or river section lined with grassy banks and trees, leading toward a lock structure in the distance. In the foreground are birch trees on the right and an open grassy area on the left. Along the bottom margin there is printed and handwritten text in Swedish, including the name Trollhättan and a caption referring to the lock section.
